name: Waste Unit Specialist
source:
A lonely voyage through space. A heart-wrenching view of dying Earth behind and the dusty surface of Mars ahead. 

Amidst your journey, you face an encounter that forces you to direct your gaze inwards.

[From [url=https://actawesomejam.itch.io/waste-disposal-specialist]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一段孤独的太空旅程。身后是垂死地球令人心碎的景象，眼前则是火星布满尘土的地表。

旅途中，你遭遇了一件事，迫使你将目光转向内心。

[来源：[url=https://actawesomejam.itch.io/waste-disposal-specialist]Itch.io[/url]]
